title: Diet Drinks or Water? A Two-Year Weight Study
paragraphs: Diet drinks have no sugar, but they taste sweet because they contain sweeteners. Some people think these drinks make it harder to lose weight. A new study tested this idea.

Researchers from the universities of Liverpool and Leeds in the UK followed 493 adults for two years. All of them were in a weight-loss programme. Half drank water every day, and the other half drank diet drinks.

After two years, the diet drink group had lost 4.8 kilos on average and the water group 3.7 kilos. The difference was very small, so the researchers say diet drinks worked about as well as water. The study was paid for by drink companies, so some experts want more research.

questions.q: Why do diet drinks taste sweet?
Why do some experts want more research?
questions.a: Because drink companies paid for the study.
